metadata.disclaimer: Original recreational basketball practice plan. Session completion does not certify proficiency. Fixed attempt counts limit dose; skill checks are self-assessed practice targets, not validated standards.

references.title: USA Basketball: Skills and Drills Levels for Coaching
USA Basketball: Foundational Ball Handling & Dribbling

movement_library.name: Court warm-up
movement_library.description: Walk for a minute, then use easy jogging, ankle rocks, arm circles and gentle side steps. Finish with three controlled stops. Keep breathing comfortable; inspect the surface for water, grit and obstacles. Easier: walk throughout.

movement_library.name: Walk and loosen up
movement_library.description: Walk until breathing settles. Gently move ankles, calves, hips and shoulders through comfortable ranges. Do not force a stretch. Reflect on one useful cue for the next session.

movement_library.name: Ball familiarity
movement_library.description: Stand balanced with soft knees. Move the ball around your waist and through a wide figure eight without bouncing; change direction halfway. Keep fingers spread and look forward between touches. Easier: slow waist circles only.

movement_library.name: Stationary control, both hands
movement_library.description: Bounce between knee and waist height beside your hip. Use finger pads and keep the hand above or beside the ball, never underneath it. Split each interval equally between hands. Look forward. Easier: use shorter intervals and glance at the ball.

movement_library.name: Walk the ball upcourt
movement_library.description: Walk 10 metres out with the right hand and back with the left. Keep the ball outside the foot and turn under control. Each repetition is one out-and-back trip. Easier: shorten to 5 metres and pause before the turn.

movement_library.name: Low crossover
movement_library.description: Move the bounce across the front of your body below the knees, then receive with the other hand. Shift your weight without slapping or carrying the ball. Split practice equally in both directions. Easier: pause after every change.

movement_library.name: Change pace, protect the ball
movement_library.description: Use two slow dribbles, a quicker push dribble, then slow down in balance. Go out right-handed and back left-handed; one trip is one repetition. Keep your free arm bent without pushing. Easier: walking pace only.

movement_library.name: Retreat and re-attack
movement_library.description: Advance three dribbles, turn your torso slightly to protect the ball, retreat two steps while dribbling, then change hand and re-attack. Alternate the starting hand. Keep eyes on the court. Easier: rehearse at a walk with pauses.

movement_library.name: Crossover into an open lane
movement_library.description: Approach a flat marker, slow down, cross low and accelerate for two dribbles into free space. Alternate directions. One effective change is enough. Easier: remove the acceleration or use a stationary crossover.

movement_library.name: Non-dominant hand control
movement_library.description: Use your non-dominant hand along a short out-and-back lane. Keep your eyes forward and the bounce by your hip. Turn slowly without switching hands. A loss means reset, not rush. Easier: stationary dribbling.

movement_library.name: Stop and pivot
movement_library.description: From one walking dribble, gather into a balanced two-foot stop. Establish one pivot foot, turn around it and pass or reset without sliding that foot. Alternate pivot feet each repetition. Easier: practice from standing without the dribble.

movement_library.name: Triple threat and first step
movement_library.description: Start in a balanced stance with the ball protected. Make a short jab step and recover, then release the dribble before lifting your pivot foot to drive. Alternate the pivot foot. Easier: practice the jab and return without driving.

movement_library.name: Layup footwork rehearsal
movement_library.description: Start close with the ball held. On the right, step right then left, rise gently from the left foot and finish with the right hand; mirror on the left. Reset after each attempt. Easier: rehearse the two steps without jumping or shooting.

movement_library.name: One-dribble layups
movement_library.description: Begin a few steps from the rim. Take one controlled dribble, gather and use right-left footwork on the right, left-right on the left. Finish with the outside hand and land balanced. Easier: use the no-dribble footwork drill. Count attempts, not makes.

movement_library.name: Both-hand finishing
movement_library.description: Alternate right and left approaches from close range. Keep the gather controlled, aim softly off the backboard and use the outside hand. Walk back between attempts. Easier: start with the ball held one step from the rim.

movement_library.name: Protect the finish
movement_library.description: Attack from the wing with one or two dribbles. Keep the ball close on the gather and finish on the side away from an imagined defender. Alternate sides. Avoid swinging elbows. Easier: unopposed one-dribble layups.

movement_library.name: Close-range form shooting
movement_library.description: Shoot from 1-2 metres with balanced feet, shooting hand under the ball and guide hand at the side. Extend smoothly and hold the follow-through. Reset your feet after each shot. Easier: move closer or use an appropriate lower hoop. Count makes out of the fixed attempts.

movement_library.name: Three-spot shooting
movement_library.description: Use left, centre and right spots 2-3 metres from the hoop. Split attempts evenly; shoot only as far as you can keep the same balanced release. Retrieve at a walk. Easier: bring every spot closer. Record makes and distance.

movement_library.name: Catch, set and shoot
movement_library.description: Have a partner pass into your shooting pocket, set your feet and release in balance. Alternate the wing you start from. Solo: gently toss the ball forward with backspin, catch after the bounce and set before shooting. Easier: stationary close shots.

movement_library.name: One-dribble pull-up
movement_library.description: From short midrange, take one controlled dribble into a balanced stop and shoot vertically. Alternate the dribbling hand. Land near your takeoff point. Easier: remove the dribble and use catch-and-shoot footwork; reduce range.

movement_library.name: Free-throw routine
movement_library.description: Choose a short repeatable routine, breathe out and take the shot without hurrying. Record makes out of attempts. Use the regulation line only if you can reach with controlled form; otherwise move closer and record that distance.

movement_library.name: Repeatable shooting range
movement_library.description: Begin at a reliable distance and keep each set at one marked spot. Move one small step back only after a balanced, consistent set. Stay inside the arc if range is not ready. Easier: shorten the distance. Record distance and makes; do not chase deep shots.

movement_library.name: Chest pass to a target
movement_library.description: From about 3 metres, step toward a chest-height target, extend both arms and finish with thumbs down. Receive with soft hands. Solo: use a safe clear wall and catch the rebound. Easier: shorten to 2 metres.

movement_library.name: Bounce pass around pressure
movement_library.description: Step toward your target and bounce the ball so it rises near the receiver's waist. Alternate the stepping foot. Keep passes firm but catchable. Solo: use a safe wall with room for the rebound. Easier: reduce distance and remove the imagined defender.

movement_library.name: Pass, cut and relocate
movement_library.description: Pass to a partner, cut toward the rim, then clear to the opposite open spot. Take turns passing and moving. Solo: rehearse a pass to a safe wall, catch it, then walk the cut without a ball. Easier: walk the pattern and pause in open space.

movement_library.name: Drive and find the open player
movement_library.description: With a passer and light help defender, drive toward a gap. If help blocks it, stop balanced and pass to the open teammate; if help stays away, finish. Rotate roles. Solo: alternate drive-and-stop pass rehearsal with a layup, but do not count it as a live decision check.

movement_library.name: Defensive slide and recover
movement_library.description: Set markers 3 metres apart. Stay low enough to move easily, push from the outside foot and slide without bringing feet together. Keep chest up and hands active. Easier: smaller steps at walking speed; stand tall between repetitions.

movement_library.name: Controlled closeout
movement_library.description: Approach from 4 metres, shorten the final steps and stop an arm's length from the shooter with one hand up. Stay balanced to slide in either direction. Never run under a shooter. Easier: walk in and pause before the defensive stance.

movement_library.name: Mirror a ball handler
movement_library.description: A partner dribbles within a 3-metre-wide lane at controlled speed. Stay between the ball and the hoop without reaching or contact; swap roles halfway. Solo: slide between markers on an irregular count. Solo practice does not assess reacting to an opponent.

movement_library.name: Find, box out, rebound
movement_library.description: Locate a partner, turn into a balanced box-out position without pushing or holding, then pursue the rebound and land with space. Start with no contact. Solo: toss softly off the backboard, turn, locate and secure the ball with two hands. Easier: catch after a bounce.

movement_library.name: One-on-one with a purpose
movement_library.description: Alternate attack and defense each possession. Start at a wing, allow at most three dribbles and work for a balanced shot. Agree on light contact and fouls first. Solo: rehearse a jab, drive and finish at each wing; live checks still need a defender.

movement_library.name: Read the closeout
movement_library.description: A partner varies a short or long closeout at controlled speed. Shoot if there is space; attack the open side if the defender closes hard. Take turns. Solo: alternate the two responses after a self-toss, without treating this as a live read.

movement_library.name: Two-on-one advantage
movement_library.description: Two attackers face one defender. The ball handler drives an open lane and passes if the defender commits; the teammate keeps a clear passing lane. Rotate roles each possession. Solo: rehearse drive, stop and pass to a wall, then work both-hand finishes.

movement_library.name: Two-on-two spacing
movement_library.description: Start with one attacker at the top and one on a wing. Read the lane, pass and cut, and keep space for the ball handler. Defenders call help early. Rotate matchups. Solo: rehearse pass-and-cut paths and catch-and-shoot; return for live practice later.

movement_library.name: Screen, use space, roll
movement_library.description: Walk through a legal stationary screen with room for a defender to avoid it. The ball handler passes close to the screen; the screener opens toward the rim or free space. Never lean, move into or blindside a defender. Solo: walk both paths around a flat marker.

movement_library.name: Help and recover
movement_library.description: Start where you can see your player and the ball. A teammate drives slowly; show help without contact, call it, then recover on the pass while staying balanced. Rotate roles. Solo: point to imagined ball and player, step into help position, then close out to a marker.

movement_library.name: Three-on-three possessions
movement_library.description: Play short half-court possessions with agreed pickup rules. Keep lanes open, move after passing and call screens on defense. Rotate teammates and matchups. Rest between blocks. Solo: combine pass-and-cut, closeouts and close-range shooting; live checks remain outstanding.

movement_library.name: Clear and restart
movement_library.description: Rebound or receive the ball under the basket, dribble or pass beyond the arc with control, then face the hoop ready to attack. Alternate hands and sides. Rehearse a top-of-arc check separately. Agree on local pickup rules. Easier: walk the route without a defender.

movement_library.name: Pickup decision review
movement_library.description: Recall the previous practice or game. Identify one preventable turnover, one useful off-ball move and one defensive communication. Pick one cue for next time. With a partner, compare what each of you saw; solo, plan the next live practice.

movement_library.name: Court run and controlled stop
movement_library.description: Mark a 10-metre lane with space beyond it. Jog out, shorten the final three steps and stop balanced before the marker; walk back to recover. One out-and-walk-back is one repetition. Start with 5 metres at an easy jog, then use a relaxed run when stops stay quiet. Do not sprint or turn sharply at the marker.

movement_library.name: Run with the ball, either hand
movement_library.description: Dribble 10 metres with one hand at an easy jog, keeping the bounce ahead and outside your foot. Decelerate over the last three steps, stop legally and walk back. Alternate hands each repetition. Look up between bounces. Easier: walk 5 metres; increase pace only while the ball stays within reach.

movement_library.name: Hesitate, then accelerate
movement_library.description: Approach a marker slowly for 3 metres. Rise slightly to sell a hesitation, keeping your hand on top or beside the ball, then take two quick attacking dribbles into the open lane. Slow down with room to stop and walk back. Alternate the attacking hand each repetition. Start at walking pace; the contrast in pace matters more than top speed.

movement_library.name: First step past a shadow defender
movement_library.description: Start on a wing in triple threat. A cooperative partner shows one open side without reaching; read that space, start the dribble before lifting your pivot foot and take at most two dribbles to a balanced layup attempt. Alternate starting wings each repetition. Reset and walk back. Solo: attack either side of a marker, keeping the same legal first step. This is a rehearsal, not a live win.

movement_library.name: One move, one counter
movement_library.description: From a wing, use a hesitation and attack. If a cooperative defender closes the lane, retreat one dribble, change hands low and attack the other side. Use no more than one counter and finish with a balanced shot attempt. Alternate starting hands each repetition. Solo: use a marker as the closed lane. Easier: rehearse slowly without a shot. Never push off with the free arm.

movement_library.name: One-on-one: win the first gap
movement_library.description: Start at a wing with the defender one arm length away and slightly to one side. Attack the open hip with a change of pace; use at most three dribbles and one shot attempt. No rebound battle. Alternate attacker and defender after every possession, and change wings halfway through. Count balanced open shots and protected finishes, not only makes. Start with cooperative defense, then progress to live resistance. Solo: rehearse both wings around a marker; record no live results.

levels.name: First Touch
levels.description: Control the ball, stop legally and build a close-range shot.

programs.title: Meet the ball
programs.description: Build a relaxed grip and a repeatable first shot.
programs.readiness: Keep eyes forward between touches. Accuracy comes before pace.
programs.safety: Use a dry, clear court and suitable shoes. Warm up before changes of direction. Keep effort controlled; take extra walking rests and stop when technique deteriorates. Do not push, undercut or make contact with a shooter in the air. Reduce speed, distance or attempts when needed; stop for pain or dizziness. Bring water and take breaks in heat. Partner drills start cooperative; solo alternatives do not replace live skill checks.
